name: degoog-extensions
description: Self-hosted degoog extensions for the operator's stack
author: roro

plugins.name: linkding
plugins.description: Integrates your self-hosted [linkding](https://github.com/sissbruecker/linkding) bookmark manager into Degoog: an "In your bookmarks" panel alongside search results. Requires Degoog 0.24.0 or newer.

engines.name: linkding Engine
engines.description: Native linkding bookmark search engine: results in a dedicated tab and via the `!linkding` bang shortcut. Which tabs it feeds is set from Degoog's own engine type override.
